name: The Drowned Choir

do.objective: The choir is down. The organ rope is by the north wall
The organ has opened the stair: the exit is behind the altar
The nave: the causeway is dry; the Drowned hold the water
The sanctuary: the loft behind the altar holds the choir

intro.title: THE DROWNED CHOIR
lines: A cathedral the sea took, and the water never left.
The choir is still in its stalls.

outro: Behind the altar a stair goes down. The water on the first steps is perfectly still.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: A cathedral up to the knees in green water, and the choir stalls are under it. Every stall is full. They are standing.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: Oilskin boots, the heel stamped with a yard number. Pender yard. Every one of them was on a boat.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The causeway is dry. The rest is wading water, and water carries the arc lamp: a charged bolt jumps between bodies standing in it, eight metres, up to eight of them.

messages.speaker: RINGING PLATE
messages.text: Run a nail down it: the stalls of this choir hold three hundred and twelve. The count says they are all present.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: The water has moved. Something has stood up in it, and something else after that.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: The transept has dry chapels at both ends, a long way off across the water. A singer stands in each, small at this distance. Neither of them is a Drowned.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: Four singers on a loft behind the altar, and the exit behind them. The Drowned stand because they are told to. These four are doing the telling.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: The ones in the low halls said these were the first. They did not say they were ours. I think they did not know.

messages.speaker: INES
messages.text: The ranks in the long gallery said the choir was theirs to keep. I did not ask who sang in it before.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The east chapel rings hollow behind its last pillar, and the floor beyond it is wet.

messages.speaker: A SILENT (NOTE)
messages.text: The way down for those of us who are carried out. Go quietly. There is a garden at the bottom, and a keeper who has been waiting.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The four on the loft are down. The Drowned are still standing, and nobody is telling them to do anything now.

messages.speaker: HULL
messages.text: The rope at the north wall rings the organ. The stair behind the altar is held shut by the choir and the organ together: it opens when the loft is silent and the rope is pulled.

objective: Walk the causeway up the nave to the sanctuary. The exit is behind the altar, and the choir that keeps the Drowned standing is between

quality.reason: the nave lost its roof when a hull came through it: the player crosses the open water on a causeway, with the Drowned in the stalls on both sides
quality.introduces: the drowned: a flooded cathedral whose choir stalls hold a crowd of the earliest conversions, a dry causeway through them, and the arc lamp's bolt jumping through the water
